newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks up after start of election campaign.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks up after start of election campaign.

text.p: Jakarta stocks edged higher in slow trading on Monday, with the focus on small property firms and newly-listed Multidana after the start of the general election campaign on Sunday, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 2.26 points, or 0.35 percent, to 654.73 points after 55 minutes of trading. Advancers led decliners by 50 to 24 with 47 issues unchanged.
"The start of the election campaign appeared to have little impact, except for the low trading volume, because it was relatively peaceful," one broker said.
